parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: Search keyword. It will match on fields such as task name, application name (appName), task description, and evaluation metric name.

parameters.name: MaxTime
parameters.description: The UTC end time of the search time range

parameters.name: MinTime
parameters.description: The UTC start time of the search time range

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. Value range: integers greater than 0. Default value: 1.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paillmtrace list-online-eval-tasks --min-time 2025-04-05_13:24:25_2025-04-05 --max-time 2025-04-07_13:24:25_2025-04-07 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --app-name my-foo-llm-app-1.0 --status CREATED_RUNNING_FINISHED_USER_CANCELED --keyword foo --sampling-method Window_Ratio --sort-by CreateTime_Status_TaskId_TaskName --sort-order ASC_DESC --region cn-hangzhou
